Complete Set This comprehensive set includes all the necessary components for a successful sea fishing trip, from the main rod to the reel and line, ensuring you're fully equipped for your adventure. Lightweight Despite its strength, the Wolf King Sea Rod Set is surprisingly lightweight, making it easy to carry and use for extended periods. Versatile Use Whether you're a professional fisherman or a beginner, this rod set is versatile enough to meet the needs of all sea fishing enthusiasts.

product.desc:
Long Casting Capability



With its superior design, this rod set offers exceptional long casting capability, making it ideal for targeting distant fish like mackerel and sea bass.






Specialized for Sea Fishing



Specifically designed for sea fishing, this rod set is perfect for anglers looking to explore the depths of the ocean and catch big game fish.






Complete Set



This comprehensive set includes all the necessary components for a successful sea fishing trip, from the main rod to the reel and line, ensuring you're fully equipped for your adventure.






Lightweight



Despite its strength, the Wolf King Sea Rod Set is surprisingly lightweight, making it easy to carry and use for extended periods.






Versatile Use



Whether you're a professional fisherman or a beginner, this rod set is versatile enough to meet the needs of all sea fishing enthusiasts.

title: JUQINWANG | Metal Light Tackle Fishing Reel Shallow Spool Smooth Long Cast
detail_text: Far Casting Capability With its advanced design, this fishing reel offers exceptional far-casting capabilities, perfect for targeting distant fish. Micro Fishing Line Compatibility Designed to accommodate micro fishing line, this reel is suitable for catching small fish, expanding your fishing possibilities. Gapless Structure The gapless structure of this reel minimizes friction, enabling smoother operation and longer casting distances. Metal Construction Crafted from durable metal, this fishing reel ensures longevity and resistance to wear and tear, ideal for rigorous sea fishing. Shallow Line Cup The shallow line cup design allows for precise casting and improved line management, enhancing your fishing experience.

page_json.category: Sports & Outdoors Activities Equipment > Outdoor Sports & Activities Equipment > Fishing
page_json.description: <html> <head></head> <body>  Far Casting Capability   With its advanced design, this fishing reel offers exceptional far-casting capabilities, perfect for targeting distant fish.    Micro Fishing Line Compatibility   Designed to accommodate micro fishing line, this reel is suitable for catching small fish, expanding your fishing possibilities.    Gapless Structure   The gapless structure of this reel minimizes friction, enabling smoother operation and longer casting distances.    Metal Construction   Crafted from durable metal, this fishing reel ensures longevity and resistance to wear and tear, ideal for rigorous sea fishing.    Shallow Line Cup   The shallow line cup design allows for precise casting and improved line management, enhancing your fishing experience.     </body></html>

aiTexts: The Sougayilang braided fishing line offers exceptional strength and durability for anglers targeting carp and other species in both freshwater and saltwater environments.
Its 9-strand high-density PE construction provides remarkable abrasion resistance and knot strength, ensuring reliability under heavy loads.
Available in three vivid, fade-resistant colors, the line maintains visibility and color vibrancy for long-lasting use.
A proprietary smooth surface coating minimizes friction, enhancing casting distance and sensitivity for a superior fishing experience.
With thin diameter and premium materials, this line delivers precise handling and long-term performance.

product.desc:
High-Performance 9-Strand Braided Line

1. 3 Vivid, Colorfast Options
    Available in three distinct, fade-resistant colors for excellent visibility on the water and lasting vibrancy.

2. 9-Strand High-Density PE Construction
    Woven from ultra-high-strength PE fibers in a dense 9-strand braid for exceptional durability, a smooth round profile, and superior abrasion resistance.

3. Smooth, Specialized Surface Coating
    A proprietary coating reduces friction for noticeably smoother, longer casts and enhanced overall performance.

4. Exceptional Strength & Toughness
    Delivers superior knot strength and abrasion resistance, built to withstand heavy loads and resist breaking.

5. Thin Diameter for Superior Handling
    A thinner profile cuts through water and wind with minimal resistance, providing increased sensitivity and excellent casting distance.

6. Premium, Long-Lasting Material
    Manufactured from high-quality fibers to ensure color retention and reliable performance over time.

Product Details:
Model: Braided Fishing Line 
Meters: 300M 500M 1000M
Weaves: 9 Strands 
3 Colors:  Blue  Green  Multicolor
Suitable: Saltwater/Freshwater

title: SHIMANO | SHIMANO SIENNA Spinning Fishing Reel Seawater/Freshwater 1000FG/2500FG/4000FG Aluminum Spool spinning reel
detail_text: There is a 1000, 2500, C3000 and 4000 size available which opens up a range of light line fishing options, from whiting through to flathead. With braided fishing line becoming more popular the Sienna reels are well suited as the AR-C spool increases distance by preventing wind knots, and smaller loops running through the stripping guide. Depending on the size, the drag power rating is between 3 and 8.5Kg which is more than enough to handle such species. Finished in a black and red cosmetic, they match great with many of Shimano’s fibreglass and graphite rods. Case Material: XT-7 Material Spools: Diecasted aluminum Bearings: 3 + 1 Handle: Screw in machined aluminum single handle

detail_text: Versatile Fishing Whether you're fishing for giant creatures or using an anchor rod, this reel is versatile enough to meet your needs. Saltwater Resistance The Haudon NGK reel is designed to withstand saltwater, making it ideal for fishing in the ocean or coastal areas. Travel-Friendly Its compact design makes it easy to carry on your outdoor adventures, whether you're camping, hiking, or traveling. Long Casting Distance This reel offers a long casting distance, allowing you to reach further into the water for a greater chance of catching fish. Metal Construction Constructed from durable metal, this reel is built to last and can handle the rigors of fishing trips.

Brand:Seasir

Name: Rexcast

Material：24T+30T Carbon Fiber

C552ML/C602ML/C662M/C662MH

Weight：95g-159g

Lure Weight(g) :4-25g

Line Weight(Lb)：5-20LB

Power：ML/M/MH

Length：1.65M-2.43M

Guide Rings:Zirconia Guide Ring

Section:2

Drag:8Kg-20Kg

Features:


1. SEASIR PLUS

True 15-month warranty


3-month free replacement of damaged rod tip! Free shipping!

3-15 months free replacement of damaged rod tip! Customer pays shipping.


The warranty covers manufacturing defects, shipping damage, and breakage during fishing.

*Improper use, wear and tear, and accidental damage are not covered.


Warranty method


Customers need to provide a genuine video of rod damage using the original purchase account to enjoy the warranty.

*Orders at risk of fraud require the damaged tip to be returned. We will provide warranty after verification.


2. Drag 8Kg-20Kg

Strong And Rigid, Specifically Designed To Handle Ferocious Fish


3. Long Cast

A Range Of Lengths Is Available. New, Longer Rods Are Offered To Provide a Longer Power Stroke, Allowing Lures To Achieve Greater Acceleration Before Release For Maximum Distance.


4. High-Carbon Fiber

ItIs Made Of 24T+30T High-Carbon Fiber Precision Work, Suitable For Ergonomics,Lightweight Non-Slip Grip, Beautiful, Comfortable And Durable.


5. Color-Changing Paint

Different Color Effects AreProduced Depending On TheLighting Conditions.


6. SmoothZirconia Guide Ring.

Stronger Impact Resistance. Can WithstandGreater Pulling Force From Large Fish WithoutEasily Deforming Smooth And Wear-Resistant Fast Heat Dissipation.


7. Comfortable skin-like grip

It Uses a Skin-Friendly Material,Making ItMore Comfortable To Hold Than EvaAnd It Is Also Non-Slip


Notice:

1. Manual Measuring, Please Allow Slightly Measurement Error.

2. Due To The Difference Between Different Monitors And Lighting Effects, The Actual Color Of The Item May Be Slightly Different From The Color Shown On The Picture

title: KastKing Sharky III Innovative Water Resistance Spinning Reel 18KG Max Drag Power Fishing Reel for Bass Pike Fishing
detail_text: Product Features: 1. Up to 39.5LBs / 18KG of smooth, reliable triple disc carbon fiber drag 2. Oversized stainless steel main shaft, and stronger precision mesh manganese brass pinion gears 3. K.I.S.S. (KastKing Intrusion Shield System). Sharky III series has a unique protection water resistant design for its spool, body, and rotor. 4. Unique Shark Fin Braid Ready aluminum spool, you no longer need to use backing line when spooling on braid fishing line. 5. 10+1 high quality, saltwater rated double shielded stainless steel ball bearings 6. Instant lock anti-reverse, stainless steel hardware, aluminum handle Powerful and Reliable *CNC Aluminum Spool *Reinforced Graphite Body *Reinforced Graphite Rotor Up to 39.5 lbs of smooth drag Direct Drive Secure-Fit Handle Shark Fin Braid-Ready Aluminum Spool K.I.S.S.（KastKing Intrusion Shield System） Innovative Water Resistance 10+1 MaxiDur Shielded Stainless Steel Ball Bearings Instant Anti-Reverse Triple Disc Carbon Drag MaxiDur Shielded Stainless Steel Ball Bearings Anti-Corrosion Zinc Alloy Drive Gear High Density EVA Grips Anti-Twist Line Roller Features of Long Cast 2500 size 1.Patent Pending Large Diameter Spool Increases casting distance and improves line control 2.Super Lightweight Carbon Body and Rotor 3.Superior Smooth Rotor Ball Bearing Ensures smooth operation and endurance Reel on the rod Item Information KastKing Sharky III Fishing Reel - NEW 2018 Spinning Reel - Carbon Fiber 39.5 LBs Max Drag - 10+1 Stainless BB for Saltwater or Freshwater - Oversize Shaft - Super Value! Third time is the charm for our New for 2018 Sharky III Spinning Reel. With the successful yet valuable experience we accumulated with the first two generations of Sharky, we upgraded the Sharky fishing reel series to the next level. Now the outstanding KastKing Sharky III is the real versatile warrior that can handle any monster from river to the ocean. The all NEW KastKing Sharky III spinning fishing reel is now lighter, smoother, and stronger! Information:

Rod Type: Carbon Steel Fishing Rod

Material: Carbon Steel

Tonality: Hard

Color: Black

Size: 1.8m/2.1m/2.4m/2.7m/3.0m

Package Included: Fishing Rod*1

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1，High quality carbon steel - Improve the overall operation of the fishing rod and the sensitivity of the rod.

2，Smooth metal guide ring - Provide you with a smoother experience and longer casting distance, also reduce the abrasion of the fishing line.

3，High strength reel seat - Holds the reel securely in place, full contact reel seat with soft-touch coatings maximize comfort and sensitivity.

4，quality and comfortable handle - Provides greater sensitivity and durability, improves your control and fishing comfort, and allows you to enjoy fishing with minimal fatigue.

5，ANTI-WINDING TOP GUIDE RING - Reduce the chances of the fishing line twisting while you are casting.

Note:

1.Products are in stock, you can buy with confidence

2.Usually we will ship the same day, the logistics information will be updated within 72 hours.

3.Arrival time is generally 5-12 days, depending on your region

4.If you are satisfied with the goods you received, please give us a 5-star rating, which is very important to us.

5.If you have received the wrong item, please contact us to resolve it for you.

6.Size and Weight for manual measurement, there may be a 0 to 1 cm error and 0 to 1g error , belongs to the normal phenomenon

7.Due to the difference between different monitors, the picture may not reflect the actual color of the item.

Thank you!

detail_html:
Basic Information

Brand: SEASIR

Product Name:Stream

Material: Carbon+Solid Wood

Guide Rings: FUJI A+O, 6+1/7+1/8+1

Length: 1.57M/1.68M/1.85M/1.98M

Model：C522UL/C562UL/C602L/C662L/S522UL/S562UL/S602L/S662L

Power: UL/L

Action: F

Weight: 78G-99G

Lure Weight: 1-10G

Line Weight:2-8LB

Section: 2

Features:

1.SEASIR 5'2”-6'6" sizes

The SEASIR stream casting/spinning rod offers exceptional value and performance for every angler and fishing application! UL/L can cope with more fishing environments and species of fish ,these fishing rods are designed for anglers looking for an incredible rod with an affordable price.

2.SEASIR FUJI A+O Guides

Japan Fuji Ceramic Guide Ring, top use Fuji a guide,strong corrosion resistance,good heat dissipation, smoother, will not wear the fishing line.The rod's design is not only functional but also aesthetically pleasing, with a premium solid wood reel seat that is both distortion-resistant and stylish. The Smooth, durable ceramic guides are a testament to the rod's commitment to longevity and performance.

3. 40T Carbon Fiber+78G Ultra-Light

The Stream rod starts with an amazing TORAY 40t high-strength lightweight carbon fiber, lightweight competitive reel seat , which not only ensures the overall strength, sensitivity and accuracy, but also provides a lighter weight fishing rod to keep the power flowing,5ft weighs only 78-86g. Ultra-Lightweight design you won't feel tired even after long-term use.

4.SEASIR Parallel Joint

Overcoming unpleasant bending and loss of strength effectively improve conductivity even weak vibrations can be clearly felt,the longer size of the interface is designed to prevent the rod from disjointing, and the interface is more stable.

5.SEASIR Solid Wood

Whether you’re targeting trout in a mountain stream or casting for bass in a lake, the SEASIR stream versatility extends to the line weight, which can accommodate a range from 2-8LB, and the lure weight which spans from 1-10G. While The SEASIR solid wood handle provides a comfortable grip.This rod is not just a tool for the fishing enthusiast; It's a companion for the adventurous angler who demands the best in both performance and design.

title: Thirty34Four Pinky 1.6lb/730g/200m
detail_text: The specific gravity of the Thirty34Four Pinky line, which is 1.38, positions it as denser compared to many other fishing lines. This higher specific gravity allows the Pinky line to sink faster in the water, providing advantages in terms of control, sensitivity, and hook-setting efficiency. In contrast, fishing lines with lower specific gravity may float more on the water's surface, impacting their performance in certain fishing scenarios. The elevated specific gravity of the Thirty34Four Pinky line contributes to its suitability for light game fishing, offering enhanced responsiveness and accuracy in presenting bait or lures to target fish at various water depths. Thirty34Four Pinky线的比重为1.38，这使得它比许多其他鱼线更密。这种较高的比重使Pinky线在水中下沉更快，在控制、灵敏度和钓钩效率方面提供了优势。相比之下，比重较低的鱼线可能更多地漂浮在水面上，从而影响其在某些垂钓场景中的表现。Thirty34Four Pinky线的较高比重增强了其在轻型游戏垂钓中的适用性，在将鱼饵或诱饵呈现给不同水深的目标鱼时提供了更高的响应性和准确性。
